stances.claim: CJ will not fly Qatar Airways anymore and will not recommend it. QR 'has failed multiple times to honor its commitments. The money part may matter, but the broken promises matter most.' A year after the July 18, 2023 incident on QR 928 where his Rimowa wheel was almost detached at NAIA -- despite a property irregularity report, ~10 follow-ups, and the Sept 18, 2023 retrieval by QR's Ruben Gallardo -- the airline has 'failed to deliver the repaired luggage or its replacement.'
Because 'other passengers may have been similarly affected,' CJ calls on 'our hardworking Transportation Secretary Jaime Bautista to discipline this carrier and its officials.'

'On a more pleasant subject,' had CJ and ~500 other MVP Group board members invested $1,000 in Nvidia Nasdaq shares in November 2023, the investment would have 'quadrupled by now to $4,000' -- CJ regrets not heeding Dr. Max Tegmark's Nov 9, 2023 MVP Group seminar talk on Nvidia as AI frontliner.

Nvidia 'is the engine of AI' -- engineering 'the most advanced chips, systems, and software for the AI factories of the future... and helps companies create their own AI factories.' Market cap 'blitzed to over $3.3 trillion,' overtaking Microsoft and Apple. Jensen Huang's net worth: $100B+.

Beyond Nvidia's new wealth, more important is 'how its AI blitz has advanced civilization and improved humanity.' Equally important is how to control AI to minimize 'ethical and social consequences such as job displacement, deep fakes, false holograms, data privacy breaches, and cybersecurity ransomware.' Which firm is most valuable matters less than 'what Nvidia can do and is doing for humans.'

Internet-era transformations catalog: Microsoft Windows on every computer; iPhone leading smartphones; Viber/iMessage/WhatsApp/email 'effectively abolished post offices and outmoded telegrams and telexes'; Alipay/Maya/GCash replacing paper money/coins/credit cards; smartphones 'long ago dumped Kodak, Canon, and other cameras'; Zoom/MS Teams/Webex for remote meetings 'from anywhere in the world'; Google/Netflix/YouTube/TikTok/Facebook/X/Instagram/Spotify changing habits of learning, communicating, and viewing. 'Truly, the internet has transformed civilization.'

Nvidia 'will open another era when it humanizes the internet and AI through the creation of human-like robots and instant access to research.' Its GPUs will revolutionize three domains: (1) healthcare (medical imaging, diagnostics, personalized medicine); (2) self-driving vehicles reducing accidents and providing 'mobility with air taxis'; (3) 'edge-computing' and IoT for connectivity-enhanced quality of life. 'More on these in another column.'

one_paragraph_summary: CJ delivers a split column. First, a sustained consumer complaint: he will not fly Qatar Airways (QR) anymore and will not recommend it because QR 'has failed multiple times to honor its commitments. The money part may matter, but the broken promises matter most.' On July 18, 2023, he arrived from Europe via Doha on QR 928 and found his Rimowa luggage's wheel almost totally detached. He reported it at NAIA and received a property irregularity report from QR agent 'Adrian.' QR's service number 'was called several times by my executive assistant Marivic Romualdez but it was always inaccessible'; their travel agent emailed Joy Alvarez-Junio (QR senior manager), who endorsed to the 'MNL LL Team,' which said it was waiting for a 'response from their partner repair shop in CDG for evaluation.' On September 18, 2023, QR's Ruben Gallardo retrieved the luggage from his home. Despite ~10 follow-up emails/calls and assurances, after a year QR 'has failed to deliver the repaired luggage or its replacement.' CJ flies to Europe today via another airline and calls on 'our hardworking Transportation Secretary Jaime Bautista to discipline this carrier and its officials.' 'ON A MORE PLEASANT SUBJECT,' had CJ and the other ~500 board directors and officers of the MVP Group invested $1,000 in Nvidia Nasdaq shares in November last year, the investment 'would have quadrupled by now to $4,000.' CJ regrets not heeding Dr. Max Tegmark, who at the MVP Group's Annual Corporate Governance Enhancement Seminar on November 9, 2023 spoke 'so highly of Nvidia as the frontliner of the incredible blitz of artificial intelligence.' Nvidia 'is the engine of AI' -- 'engineers the most advanced chips, systems, and software for the AI factories of the future... and helps companies create their own AI factories.' Its market capitalization 'has blitzed to over $3.3 trillion, overtaking Microsoft (and erstwhile second-placer Apple) as the most valuable company in the world.' Co-founder/president/CEO Jensen Huang's net worth has grown to $100B+. Beyond wealth, what matters more is 'how its AI blitz has advanced civilization and improved humanity' -- and how to control AI to minimize ethical/social consequences 'such as job displacement, deep fakes, false holograms, data privacy breaches, and cybersecurity ransomware.' The question of which company is most valuable matters less than 'what Nvidia can do and is doing for humans.' CJ catalogs internet-era transformations: every computer needs Microsoft Windows; the iPhone leads smartphones; Viber, iMessage, WhatsApp, and email 'have effectively abolished post offices and outmoded telegrams and telexes'; Alipay, Maya, and GCash replace paper money, coins, and credit cards; smartphones 'long ago dumped Kodak, Canon, and other cameras'; Zoom, MS Teams, and Webex enable remote meetings 'from anywhere in the world'; Google, Netflix, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, X, Instagram, and Spotify have changed habits of learning, communicating, and viewing. 'Truly, the internet has transformed civilization.' Nvidia 'will open another era when it humanizes the internet and AI through the creation of human-like robots and instant access to research.' Its GPUs and superior chips will revolutionize three domains: (1) healthcare via medical imaging, diagnostics, personalized medicine; (2) self-driving vehicles reducing traffic accidents with 'mobility with air taxis'; (3) 'edge-computing' and Internet of Things delivering connectivity-enhanced quality of life. 'More on these in another column.'
